note: Slide 3's headline ran across the bottle. Measured rather than eyeballed: walking each hero image left to right until a column stops being dark and flat gives the usable clear width — slide 1 is clear to 59% (855px at 1440), slide 2 to 68% (979px), but slide 3 only to 38% (540px). All three slides inherited content_max_width 700, so slide 3 alone overflowed its clear zone by ~160px. Set to 452 = 540 minus the 48px page gutter and a 40px gap before the subject. Slides 1 and 2 are left at 700, which their measurements comfortably allow. content_max_width is a range with min 400, max 1200, STEP 20 — 452 was rejected with 422 'must be a step in the range'. 440 is the nearest valid value at or below the target, keeping the text box inside the clear zone once the 48px page gutter is added (440+48=488 < 540).
